crossRefs.note: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
however the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron…
Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
“Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue…

people.name: Naamah
people.line: Daughter of Lamech and Zillah, sister of Tubal-cain.

people.name: Zillah
people.line: Wife of Lamech; mother of Tubal-Cain and Naamah

translations.web: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.
translations.bsb: And Zillah gave birth to Tubal-cain, a forger of every implement of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
translations.kjv: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.
translations.asv: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
